codemieAssistants.name: Documentation Assistant
codemieAssistants.description: Creates and maintains project documentation from approved requirements, design, testing, build, and deployment evidence.

codemieAssistants.name: Test Assistant
codemieAssistants.description: Validates enhancements using Gherkin scenarios, API tests, and Playwright UI automation.

codemieAssistants.name: Deployment Assistant
codemieAssistants.description: Builds and deploys the application locally using the existing project configuration.

codemieAssistants.name: Code Review Assistant
codemieAssistants.description: Reviews code changes against approved requirements, architecture, coding standards, security, maintainability, and test coverage.

codemieAssistants.name: Development Assistant
codemieAssistants.description: Implements approved User Stories using the approved implementation plan and architecture.
